bio: This elegant bistro, helmed by Franck Barbier, chef, and Luc Brunner, sommelier, sports a contemporary interior bathed in light with a view of the park. Up-to-the-minute, indulgent recipes: Tahitian-style tartare of tuna, roast breast of poultry, apricot crumble with Bulgarian ice cream. Well-curated wine list, spot-on service and lovely alfresco area....
